settings.label: About
settings.heading: A little world of beautiful things.
settings.body:
Launched in October 2026, Mayaloka is an Indian lifestyle brand housing two distinctive product lines — Fashion Jewellery and Scented Candles.

Old in the way we look. New in the things we make. Thoughtfully created jewellery, gifts and little worlds, inspired by the India we grew up around.

settings.label: A Little World of Beautiful Things
settings.heading: Mayaloka means a magical world.
settings.body:
But for Gowri, it means something a little more. Mayaloka is where old meets new, where everything Gowri grew up around meets everything she is building today. It is a world shaped by nostalgia, creativity, self-expression and the simple joy of finding something beautiful.

And Loka to her is more than a name. It represents the many worlds she hopes to create. One Loka might hold jewellery. Another might hold candles. Another might become something she hasn't even imagined yet.

Different products. Different stories. Different little worlds, all living under one roof. And so began Mayaloka.

settings.label: Where It Began
settings.heading: How her mother taught her to create.
settings.body:
Lifestyle and fashion have always intrigued Gowri. In some way, they have been a part of her for as long as she can remember. She grew up watching her mother make the simplest things beautiful.

Her mother taught her how to hold a needle, how to sew a design onto a piece of cloth, how to put colours together and how to make the most beautiful pair of earrings. But more than that, she taught Gowri how to create — how to begin with very little and make something of it, how to trust her hands, her imagination and her instinct.

She taught Gowri that style didn't have to come from a rulebook. It could be something so personal that it belonged only to you. And without realising it, she was learning much more than craft — she was learning how to make a world of her own.

settings.label: Old Meets New
settings.heading: Old in the way we look. New in the things we make.
settings.body:
There is a little bit of the old in everything I love. Faded paint on old buildings. Hand-painted signs. Worn textures. Nostalgic colours. The little details I grew up seeing around me. These became the visual language of Mayaloka — shaping our colours, typography, packaging and design.

And then comes the new: the things we create today. Modern jewellery, candles, gifts and the many worlds still to come. That is where Mayaloka lives.

settings.quote: This is Mayaloka. A tribute to creativity. A tribute to curiosity. And most importantly, a tribute to the woman who taught Gowri how to begin with nothing and create something beautiful. This is Gowri's Mayaloka. Welcome to the world.

settings.heading: What makes our craftsmanship premium?
